en.title: Blackpink's Jisoo Confirms Resident Evil Ada Wong Homage in Music Video
en.summary: K-pop superstar Jisoo has officially confirmed a deliberate nod to a beloved Resident Evil character in her latest music video. Fans were quick to spot the striking resemblance, leading to the star's own confirmation of the homage.
en.body:
Global music phenomenon **Blackpink**'s **Jisoo** has delighted fans by confirming that a key look in her solo music video for "Addicted" is a direct homage to **Ada Wong**, the enigmatic operative from the **Resident Evil** series. The music video, which dropped over Halloween weekend, features **Jisoo** in a series of striking outfits. However, one particular ensemble—a short black bob paired with a form-fitting red dress—immediately resonated with fans of the survival horror franchise.

Fans took to social media and **Jisoo**'s own app to question the visual parallel. "Red outfit + short hair look is totally Ada Wong from Resident Evil," one fan observed. To the excitement of many, **Jisoo** not only acknowledged the comparison but enthusiastically embraced it. "I love Biohazard (Resident Evil) sooo much, so I wanted to copy it," she revealed, cementing the connection.

## A Shared Love for Survival Horror

**Jisoo**'s affinity for the **Resident Evil** series is well-documented. Earlier this year, she spoke about her passion for the games on the popular web series *Hot Ones*. Describing her "addiction" to the franchise, she explained, "It’s fast-paced. Something will suddenly pop out at you, so you have to be quick and process it all and take care of the situation. That’s why it’s able to hold my attention, and time just flies by." This candid admission underscores her deep appreciation for the series' signature blend of suspense and action, elements that clearly inspired her artistic choices.

## Fan Frenzy and K-Pop Connections

The visual connection to **Ada Wong** has sparked considerable buzz within both the K-pop and gaming communities. It's not the first time a K-pop artist has drawn comparisons to the iconic **Resident Evil** character. In August, **Babymonster**'s **Asa** also garnered similar fan comments after posting photos featuring a black bob and red dress, leading to the playful fan moniker 'Asa Wong.' While **Asa** has yet to comment publicly, **Jisoo**'s open confirmation solidifies the enduring appeal of **Ada Wong**'s distinctive style and its impact on contemporary pop culture.

## What's Next

Fans will undoubtedly be rewatching **Jisoo**'s "Addicted" music video with a new appreciation for its **Resident Evil**-inspired aesthetic. While no further collaborations or direct **Resident Evil**-related projects have been announced, **Jisoo**'s confirmed fandom suggests her appreciation for the series may continue to influence her future creative endeavors.

content_raw: Blackpink’s Jisoo has confirmed that she referenced Resident Evil’s Ada Wong in the music video for her solo song, Addicted. The song debuted over Halloween weekend, with its accompanying music video showing Jisoo wearing a variety of different looks. One of these outfits, however, struck a chord with certain members of her fanbase due to how startlingly similar it looked to a character from Resident Evil . At the beginning of the music video, Jisoo wears a black bob and a red bodycon-style dress — a look that’s basically synonymous with Ada Wong, who almost always wears some variation of this style in each game she appears in. Fans couldn’t help but notice the similarities and asked the K-pop star if this was intentional on her very own app. “Red outfit + short hair look is totally Ada Wong from Resident Evil,” one wrote. Surprisingly, Jisoo confirmed that this was actually intentional. "I love Biohazard (Resident Evil) sooo much, so I wanted to copy it,” she said in a reply. Jisoo is open about her love for Resident Evil; she spoke about the series on Hot Ones earlier this year, saying she was “addicted” to the games. “It’s fast-paced,” she explained. “Something will suddenly pop out at you, so you have to be quick and process it all and take care of the situation. That’s why it’s able to hold my attention, and time just flies right by.” Funnily enough, Jisoo isn’t the only K-pop star to draw comparisons with Ada Wong recently; in August, Babymonster’s Asa received similar comments from fans after she posted photos of herself on social media wearing a black bob and a red dress , sparking a cute portmanteau of ‘Asa Wong’ from her fanbase. While Asa hasn’t yet responded to these remarks, Jisoo is an unabashed fan of the games, to the point where she made sure Ada was somehow represented in her latest song. In other Resident Evil news, Zach Cregger, who directed the series’ most recent movie adaptation, said he would still like to be involved in some way if a sequel gets made, though not as a director. Thus far, it’s unclear whether or not another Resi movie is in the works, but given that Capcom has doubled down on its plans to continue expanding its IP with merch, new content, and movies, it’s possible that we get another look at Raccoon City — especially given how successful the first film was at the box office .
